verdict.rationale: Milvus documents RBAC that finely controls user operations at the collection, database, and instance levels. That lets you create a least-privilege identity for an agent, for example one used by the official MCP server. The evidence shows only role-based user permissions, though, not a flow for issuing scoped API credentials to agents. Missing for 10: scoped API key/token issuance, agent-specific credential workflow (e.g. MCP server auth scoping), credential expiry/rotation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
